LOCATION: RECUMBANCY CHAMBER - ARCOLOGY DESIGNATION "007"; DATE: XX-XX-UE45 ERROR --- ... =========================================
XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - NULL. [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … [steps approach the microphone]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [sounds of rustling, someone taking a seat on a humming grav-chair]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I don't understand why people like to make these – voice logs I mean – I've always found them silly. Best thoughts are usually kept in my head. I'd like to think the only thoughts worth writing down are notes–the academic, prolific ones.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Maybe I can at least ... you know. Recording things could maybe help me get a grip on the situation?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Or … whatever …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [long sigh and then rustling]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I've been locked inside the recumbency chamber. Blame the Military Department and Nielst …The arcology barriers haven't been fully activated, but I'm still locked inside this room without the proper genopticon creds.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Outside communications have been deactivated. Actually, hell. All Interior communications have been deactivated as well. Full comms black-out.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Anyone who could help me is on the floor above, separated by the cooker. Person-baker? Microwaving hall of death? … Need a better name for that.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … I only have local access to the network. File checking, writing, recordings. I can't even access any of my own research. No net either.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Isn't all bad, there's a pachinko machine in the corner–not that I've ever really enjoyed that kind of stuff ...
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Since this is a recumbency chamber, it comes with some amenities. A full bathing complex. A meal apparater with a couple thousand recipes built in. A natural retreat, fresh water supply…
{{yellow|[####:] //}} And to think this is apparently one of the less furnished recumbency arcologies.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Yeah, it could use a little bit more when talking about … recreational pass-times. But this works!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [audible sigh] …
{{yellow|[####:] //}}… Ok, sure … I'm trying to cope with the fact that something awful is happening.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} To be honest, I don't know which to feel, the immense hatred and anger that I have for Dr. Nielst as he steals my research and uses it to elevate his ego. Or, be horrified by the fact that if his operator screws this synthesis pattern up, something absolutely horrible can happen.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I … I don't want to admit it but I think I got Morhan …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [Sound of rustling, then sipping] … ugh, this blue soda slop is awful, 35 flavours–all the same shit. Wanted lemon’plosion–nope, get this baja-blast crud instead … Anyways. Guess I'll just wait here, the synthesis doesn't start until a few hours from now, so. Won't know if they failed until then.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I'll definitely know if they failed.
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - SEVERAL HOURS. [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … I awoke to sirens this evening, the whole facility practically screaming at me. Something happened and I think I know what.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Quarantines in effect, they failed the synthesis …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I don't know how catastrophic it was, but for a brief moment I caught some kind of … miasma? Seeping through crevices in the walls.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It smelled awful, like freshly butchered meat, but more sickly … then the arcology's defenses activated, purging it.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I still can't tell what's going on outside the chamber. None of the communications have opened. The microwave emitters and normality barriers are fully active though.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Maybe once some of the initial systems are shocked; they may be redirected here to the recumbency chamber. If so, I might be able to get an idea of what's going on up there. But I have to wait to know …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Why do I feel so nauseous? …
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - SEVERAL HOURS. [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} My hunch was right, the systems upstairs are failing and being rerouted to the arcology. The mainframe in the hub activated a minute ago, all I can see right now are diagnostic reports of the biohazard spreading.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Calling this a biohazard is a huge understatement.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It's a damn xenophage, exactly what I feared.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It's living, thinking, flesh — genes, but without directive. It's only prerogative is to grow. And that even means consuming other biomass around it to do so. With or without whatever-it is’ consent. I can't really be sure of what happens to the infected, if it's anything like what happened to the vermin then …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Hopefully, no one is hurt …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} No access to security yet, cameras are fed to the overwatch points, so … locked out of that. The only access I have now is the facility’s diagnostics index.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Surely people are okay? People made it out, right?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I feel sick again, I need to lay down …
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - SEVERAL HOURS. [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … [sounds of weeping approach the microphone.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Five hundred.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … More than five-hundred.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} The Security Team? All listed as dead. Science crew, only survivors, me and someone? Who knows who …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I can't even stomach looking at that list, I couldn't even check the biomonitors, too much of a coward.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} No …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} No! You can't sit here and tell me it's my fault!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It's not my fault! If it was me up there, handling all of this, this would have never happened!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Why did I accept this project? Why did I think for even one goddamn second that the UECC cared about safety and ethics?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} We threw our ethics away when we let those Coven freaks bond with our aristocrats.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I created this. It's my responsibility. Had I just stepped away, maybe none of this would have happened.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I just had to pursue the answer.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I … didn't make this.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} This wasn't my fault. I just … crushed the numbers, I research chemical structures, I synthesize serums, I jot down the notes, I apply theoretical practices for the utmost safety. I. do. these. things.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I didn't do this.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} This wasn't my fault …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [Light coughing.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … the stomach pain is coming back. I need to go lay down.
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - SEVERAL HOURS [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [Severe coughing …]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Something isn't right …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [Coughing continues…]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I've been sick since my last rest. Vomiting, dark veins around my eyes, mouth, ears …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Pus, legions, browning nails, and my eyes turning yellow. Jaundice, anemia, hypotension …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I crawled to the biodistillery to do a blood sample. Still waiting for the results.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [Coughing intensifies.]
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= 07:37.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - SEVERAL HOURS [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I'm infected …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} But, how? I … when was I exposed?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It doesn't matter now. I have to act fast, create some kind of antigen.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … But it's … it's hard, I barely have the energy to walk.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I can barely feel the right-half of my body.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It … it twitches, sometimes like … it's reacting without me …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Like my body isn’t my own …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} What’s happening to me?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I have to find some way out of this, I have to do something …
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - ONE DAY [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I … I made it through?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I'm still me, yes?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I'm still … here …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I'm unsure if I would call this “surviving” the xenophage.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It came with a cost. My flesh.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I've … always wanted to ascend, to be a true aristocrat.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I've had my fair share of implants and tech-integrations. But giving my flesh wholly to a synthetic shell? I've always been somewhat… hesitant. It's the new craze sure but. It's just a bit scary.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} These shells, fully synthetic bodies you can change just as easily as you would clothes. If they break, it's okay. You're neurally ejected from the body before anything violent can even traumatize you–a fresh new shell is fabricated almost instantly, clean of scars and hardship. Delivered to your nearest CRADLE ready for your psyche to take over.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … I say this like I'm mocking this body, like it isn't my reality now.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Am I even … in this reality still? [Laughter…]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} No, no. This. This was the only way. I had no other choice. The infection was overtaking me, it felt like my own flesh and bone was starting to rebel against me.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Still, I can't believe that passage was locked away. If I hadn't seen the rooms’ layout overview in the system, I would have never found it.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} A C.R.A.D.L.E With an “S-Series” - “IDOL” Shell premapped. Ready for neural integration.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I had no other choice. I locked my neural synapses in, primed my engram, and here I am.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I feel … strange?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} The guide says it clearly. I don't have to breathe anymore, but I still breathe out of habit? I blink because it was natural to me, but I don’t have to anymore. New optics with self-cleaning sphericals. Lungs are replaced with oxygen saturators that simulate breathing. My movement feels smooth, elegant. Like these muscles have carried this thing for ages.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I weigh almost half a ton apparently, and can barely feel the difference.
I haven’t yawned, I don’t feel tired … In fact , I haven't felt hungry, fatigued or even had the need to go. I haven't felt anything other than the shells' very sensitive touch receptors.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I looked in the mirror and I saw myself but … my face is different now, someone else's face. The proprietary models right out the box typically have faces modeled off of their creators or young models. This one? A young woman's face. Demure, elegant, and yet somehow bold and fox-like.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} A beautiful face.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} But not my face.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I will say … the doll-like joints and petite physique is … oddly satisfying. This? I can get used to it.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I can still taste food, I can still hear my favorite music and enjoy it. This body comes with a bunch of modules and implants …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I was hoping to have some kind of celebration for becoming an aristocrat. My mask isn't even properly marked.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Just have to get out of here …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Damn it, I hope my old body doesn't start reeking.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} What a morbid thought …
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - ONE DAY [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} The communications array is up! I was finally able to make contact with the surface! Well, kind of. I was able to listen to incoming message relays.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} They are aware of the quarantine lockdown and are preparing a task force to purge the upper levels. Yes!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I learned another thing about these shells: I don't have to sleep anymore, I can enter a hibernation state whenever I want to but -… I don't have to sleep, and I think I still dream?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I think that was a dream … I saw Morhan, Xeveye, Adul, Kashur … they were staring at me like I had done something wrong. Like they were judging me …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Judging me for surviving?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I keep trying to tell them I'm sorry.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I'm sorry for failing you. I'm sorry for not being there.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Or … are they jealous I’m still alive? Am I being haunted?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} The systems in the arcology are coming to life one by one. And with each individual system, secrets above are revealed.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I'm scared to know what happened …
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - ONE DAY [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Camera feed swapped to the mainframe …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … [shivering … whimpering]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} The … xenophage … evolved. In a way I could have never even imagined.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It's learned to mutate host-genomes' characteristics, mimicking genomic structures and then rapidly mutating its host compounds to meld infected flesh to its desired shape and function. It is indiscriminate– the weak, the strong, the young, the old … treating biomass as not just sustenance, but foundation.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … the cameras. The lab is unrecognizable …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It's … hell. Things shambling in dark halls caked in biomass, the faint figures in the flesh – colleagues… people I knew.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Their faces … [whimpering …]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I … recall that … some of the rodent tests gave way to … “talkative tumors,” we nicknamed them. Once, right before disposing of one in the incinerator, I heard it say, “purpose.”
{{yellow|[####:] //}} That's what it wanted. What this … parasite is taking from us. The infected’s psyche is taken and stored. unravelled, sifted through, and then organized. They are unmade just to serve these things’ “purpose.”
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Such suffering is unimaginable.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} And … It's my fault.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I … caused this suffering.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … I don’t … I don’t feel well.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … I need to lay down.
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - ONE DAY [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … [sounds of metallic pacing, low muttering, something approaches the microphone]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … The recumbency arcology’s systems are fully operational. Power-draw’s not too bad, this thing could stay powered for literal eons. More, if you really wanted to sit here bored as hell for your entire life.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …[waivering sigh] … Not going to be me.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … [sounds of grav chair swiveling, taps on holographic monitor are heard, boot up sequences]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Let’s see … Communications arrays are reaching surface-side. Gotta let someone know I am down here …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … [open static] This is ######## reaching out from UVA-TECH proprietor site L-386-GMF. Clearance Level Zenith, reaching out from the Recumbency Arcology located at local stratum zero-seven. Facility in QUARANTINE, repeat—Facility in Lockdown QUARANTINE Requesting immediate assistance.
{{white|[AMB:] //}} … [static captured, sounds of possible responses.]
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … This is Command Station X-0001 Responding. We are aware of the conditions of Site L-386 and are assembling proper responses in lieu of Quarantine Protocol Initiatives … Hang tight ######## we're working on it.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … There are more survivors here … I’m simply acting as a liaison.
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … How many are we talking here?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … 30 or more … they may not appear on the Biometric Overview, too deep in the complex.
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … Understood #######, we’ll keep that in mind while we plan operations. Are you and the others safe?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … For now, it seems. The Recumbency Chamber has fully sealed off all access to other floors so … I think we’re okay for now.
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … Confirmed. Delivering OP-TAC to proper channels. Over and Out.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Over and out …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … [Movement, and a sigh. Pulls away from recorder to chuckle for a moment.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Had to lie. Had to.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … If they knew I’m the only one here, they might …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … I had to do it …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … I have to get out of here.
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - A FEW HOURS [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{white|[AMB:] //}} … [static captured, recording automation initiated.]
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … This is Command reaching out to survivors of Event 396. Please respond if you can hear this. I repeat. This is Command reaching out to survivors of Event 396. Respond.
{{white|[AMB:] //}} … [sounds of rustling around the bed, metallic footsteps rush up to the mic.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … This is ######### responding!
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … Good to hear you #########, could you provide us with a sitrep?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … The situation hasn’t changed. Genopticon is locked down so we have no access upstairs, food is okay but the apparator is malfunctioning. No one is showing signs of genetic comparability. We’re still clean here.
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … Good, we’ve done a few structural scans and noted the infestation. We’re currently assembling a PURGE Squad to infiltrate the facility at 00:00 hours. Stay away from all apertures, entrances and exits leading into upper-levels.
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … Once the PURGE Squad has cut a swath through the facility, we will rendezvous at the recumbency chamber, be prepared to evacuate immediately. Understood?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Understood.
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … Confirmed. Switching to open channels. Over and Out.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … [a sigh of relief can be heard of the recorder.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … [laughter and with sudden exuberance]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Yes! Soon I’ll be free of this hell! I won’t be stuck in here too much longer!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … I should watch their progress from the camera feed, the PURGE Squad should be able to handle anything thrown at them. Some mindless xenophage has nothing on them!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Finally … I can eat something other than apparated meals soon.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Time to keep an eye on the feed.
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - A FEW HOURS [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{white|[AMB:] //}} … [slow steps approaching the microphone.]
{{white|[AMB:] //}} … [sounds of a grav chair … low shaky whimpering.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … They’re all dead.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … The whole PURGE Squad, they’re gone.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Overwhelmed, destroyed. Turned.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … The xenophage, it's not just evolving it's adapting, instantly reacting on both a genetic and intellectual level.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … God … I can still hear their screams, I can sti—
{{white|[COMM:] //}} This is COMMAND reaching out to all survivors of Event 398. We've lost contact with our Rescue Team. Command is reassessing the situation and will respond shortly with updated information and an elevated response to the Quarantine Event. Stand by for more announcements.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Elevated response? What's worse than a PURGE Squad? …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Is there anything worse than a PURGE Squad?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Well, whatever it is, I hope it stands a better chance than they did …
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - ONE DAY [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION [X] VIDEO RECORDING INCLUDED =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [approaches the terminal, excited laughter.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} This body is incredible! Look!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [Steps away from the panel, they lean back doing a handspring before transitioning into a series of flips.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [does a full splits and then throws up there hands with jasm]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [distant] Did you see that!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [runs back up to the terminal, excited]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I knew these things were top-of-the-line! But ~wow~! I could never dream of doing anything like that in my old body!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Not that … I ever tried.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} My old body felt the sting of age. But, these shells, there’s none of that.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} You feel like you are at your youngest, everyday!
{{yellow|[####:] //}} And if you thought that was amazing, this thing has a gravitational inverter! I can fly.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Well, float? Float with direction? You get it.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Well, I’m off to see how many laps I can do running across the walls.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I’ll return with an update in a bit!
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - A FEW DAYS [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION [X] VIDEO RECORDING INCLUDED =========================================
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [video opens with the subject sitting in a tucked position in their grav chair, shivering.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [seems to have trouble trying to get out what they are about to say]
{{yellow|[####:] //}}I-I heard … banging in the walls not a moment ago.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … From the secret chamber by the wall tables.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … Banging …and horrid wailing, screaming noises.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I walked up to the wall, I think it— knew … it knew I was there somehow?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It opened the door—my … corpse. But it was alive–mangled, mutated by the xenophage. This whole time, it was being brought back to life, reanimated … changed.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It rushed at me, screaming. I was frozen—I-I thought it was over. The look on its face … my face …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Then my vision went red—flooded with warning errors—the-THREAT indication. I was moving without my own input, my body was moving on its own. No longer regarding my fear–my horror.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} It attacked, but this body didn’t waiver, it forced my old corpse back into the chamber. And then slayed it—a blade came out of my arm and bisected it–with ease.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Then, everything went quiet …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I … I just sat there staring at the gurgling thing, staring back at me with, my own eyes, filled w-with … hate? Fear? Jealousy?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [there is an audible shivering, and whimpering.] Then it went still.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I can’t stop shaking …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} This shell …it took control from me—sure it was out of defense, it was to preserve me … Or itself? Us.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I’m no longer a “person” anymore, am I?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I really did give up everything just to live, as what? A ghost of myself?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Maybe, the thing I cut down–no, this … ‘program’ in me cut down to protect itself. That was what was left of me.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I … whatever is sitting in this chair.
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I am no longer ########## …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … is this even me anymore? …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [whimpering turns into sobbing.]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
— [END ENCODED RECORDING] —

========================================= XX:XX.UDC // XX-XX-XXXX GWT EST. TIME SINCE LAST MESSAGE - A FEW HOURS [E] AUDIO LOG - {{red|ERROR - DATA CORRUPTION}} [X] TEXT LOG - AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION =========================================
{{white|[AMB:] //}} [COMMS showing .]
{{white|[COMM:] //}} This is an Automated message from CC projecting globally, reaching out to all survivors of Event 387. We are currently experiencing… –[interruption]– …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} [approaches the terminal in confusion.] W-what?
{{white|[COMM:] //}} … a galaxy-wide emergency has issued regardin_[static] –oven r—[static].......
{{white|[AMB:] //}} [sounds of frustration, possible items being thrown, a loaded slam]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} What! What galaxy-wide emergency?! …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} What could be worse than this?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Command! Explain yourself! …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
{{white|[AMB:] //}} [dead static over the void]
{{yellow|[####:] //}} …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … what the fulcrete …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} … How long am I going to be down here?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I can’t even sleep anymore. I keep dreaming. Surely this thing has a way to turn off dreams?
{{yellow|[####:] //}} Had … a nightmare. I was standing in the dark halls of the genopticon. No lights, just the crimson glow of something ahead of me ...
{{yellow|[####:] //}} A dark figure, its silhouette stumbling towards me. It was … me, that monster … the husk shambling down the halls towards me. Mouthing something …
{{yellow|[####:] //}} I tried to turn away and run, but then my vision went red. I started marching towards it, I couldn’t stop, as much as I wanted too ...
{{yellow|[####:] //}} What was it saying?
